description: This file defines the ExistsNode class, which represents an 'exists' predicate node in an abstract syntax tree for RQL (Resource Query Language). It includes methods for accessing its property, accepting visitors, and standard object overrides.

classes.name: ExistsNode
classes.description: Represents an 'exists' predicate node with a property name to check for existence.

methods.name: ExistsNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the node with a property name.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Returns the property name associated with this exists node.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor to perform operations based on the visitor pattern.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the property value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the property.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ExistsNode.
